name: robots/evronix__quadruped_sim2sim
title: evronix quadruped ROS 2 Gazebo sim2sim
intro: evronix quadruped ROS 2 Gazebo sim2sim, adapted from evronix/quadruped_sim2sim. It reads `read_joint_states` and `read_imu`; runs `publish_velocity_command`. `publish_velocity_command`: publish one PoseStamped velocity setpoint on /robot_velocity_command; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
